You can change your name whenever you want.
Your goals can change with you.
A small gesture, at your own pace.
Taking care of yourself also means listening to yourself.

step0.title: Welcome to e9.
step0.body: Your calorie, macro and water journal. A space to take care of yourself, at your own pace.

step1.title: What's your name?
step1.body: Tell us what you'd like to be called. Your name will bring your Journal's greeting to life.
step1.namePlaceholder: What you'd like to be called
step1.nameHint: We'll use your initial for the avatar.
step1.previewLabel: THIS IS HOW YOU'LL LOOK IN YOUR JOURNAL
step1.quote: A space to take care of yourself, at your own pace.

step2.title: Your goals, your way.
step2.body: Enter your daily calorie and macro goals. You decide every number.
step2.note: These are your own personal goals, not recommendations from e9. You can edit them later in your Journal.

step3.title: Every drop counts.
step3.body: Choose how much water you want to log each day. This goal is yours to set too.
step3.personalBody: It's a goal you chose, not a recommendation. You'll be able to adjust it later.

step4.body: Your space already has your name and your goals. Now you can start your Journal.
step4.summaryNote: These are the goals you chose. You can change them in your Journal whenever you need to.
